shelters.name: Humane Society of Pulaski County
shelters.description: Arkansas' only 4-star rated animal welfare charity since 1946. Private no-kill shelter supported solely by donations, typically housing about 200 animals at a time.

shelters.name: Little Rock Animal Village
shelters.description: Little Rock's municipal animal shelter with fully staffed veterinary clinic caring for thousands of animals yearly, plus adoption center with five large play yards for dogs.

shelters.name: Friends of the Animal Village
shelters.description: Nonprofit supporting Little Rock Animal Village through donations, fundraisers, awareness campaigns, and improving quality of life for shelter animals.

shelters.name: CARE for Animals
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit created in 1998, devoted to rescue/adoption, spay/neuter, pet food pantry, and fundraising efforts with hundreds of volunteers.

shelters.name: North Little Rock Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Municipal animal shelter serving North Little Rock with animal control and adoption services.

shelters.name: Humane Society of the Ozarks
shelters.description: Founded in 1944, 501(c)3 nonprofit servicing Northwest Arkansas. Programs include low cost spay/neuter vouchers, emergency vet care, and companion animal rescue.

shelters.name: NWA Humane Society for Animals
shelters.description: Local no-kill shelter helping animals find loving homes since 1963 in Northwest Arkansas.

shelters.name: Northeast Arkansas Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1971, 501c nonprofit animal shelter devoted to placing surrendered or abandoned pets into loving homes across Northeast Arkansas.

shelters.name: Sebastian County Humane Society (HOPE Humane Society)
shelters.description: Established in 1937, dedicated to prevention of cruelty, relief of animal suffering, placement in responsible homes, and humane education.

shelters.name: Fort Smith Animal Haven
shelters.description: Provides non-lethal solutions to homeless, abandoned, and feral animal population through reunification, adoption, or transport to areas with higher adoption rates.

shelters.name: The Artemis Project
shelters.description: Fort Smith and Arkansas River Valley animal rescue offering adoption, fostering, and donation opportunities.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Garland County
shelters.description: Making a difference in the lives of animals in Hot Springs and throughout Arkansas with shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: Hot Springs Village Animal Welfare League
shelters.description: Volunteer-run organization paying for food, veterinary expenses, and supplies for shelter animals. Achieved 94.5% save rate in 2024, qualifying as no-kill shelter.

shelters.name: Guardian Angels Cat Rescue and Adoption Shelter
shelters.description: Cat rescue and adoption shelter serving the Hot Springs area.

shelters.name: Paws and Claws Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving the Hot Springs area.

shelters.name: Conway Animal Welfare Unit
shelters.description: Municipal animal welfare unit serving Conway and Faulkner County.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Faulkner County
shelters.description: Humane society serving Faulkner County with animal welfare and adoption services.

shelters.name: Jefferson County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Pine Bluff and Jefferson County with animal rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Saline County
shelters.description: Humane society serving Saline County with animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Central Arkansas SPCA
shelters.description: SPCA serving Central Arkansas with animal welfare and adoption services.

shelters.name: Big Paws of the Ozarks
shelters.description: Rescues, fosters, and finds loving homes for large breed dogs, advocating for animal welfare and community education on pet care.

shelters.name: Fayetteville Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Municipal animal shelter serving Fayetteville with animal control and adoption services.

shelters.name: Animal League of Washington County
shelters.description: Animal rescue league serving Washington County in Northwest Arkansas.

shelters.name: ArkanPaws Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving Conway County and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: Last Chance Arkansas
shelters.description: Saves animals from euthanasia by offering medical care, fostering, and adoption services.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Arkansas animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Coverage spans Little Rock metro, Northwest Arkansas (Fayetteville, Rogers, Bentonville), Fort Smith, Jonesboro, Hot Springs, Conway, and Pine Bluff areas. Humane Society of Pulaski County is Arkansas' only 4-star rated animal welfare charity.
